summary.headline: Astrological Inquiry Chapters
summary.text: Catalog entries 215–230 cover inquiries about brothers, markets, offspring, land, estates, wealth, acquisition, quantity, bathing, shaving, garments, and metalwork. They then list tables on signs, stars, exaltations, depressions, houses, aspects, and geometric figures, followed by a Persian astronomical-art book using an astrolabe or horologion and chapter headings on marriage, star judgments, sects, the tail, pivotal stars, and inquiries.
